newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks down one percent in the week.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks down one percent in the week.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange took a downturn in the week to Wednesday with the index falling by over one percent, a Muscat Securities Market report said.
The index closed 2.26 points lower at 184.99 points.
Of the 60 companies traded in the week, shares of 41 fell, six rose, and 13 were unchanged, the MSM said.
Bank shares accounted for 65 percent of total trading value of 4.81 million rials ($12.6 million) from 5.57 million rials the previous week.
National Bank of Oman and Oman International Bank were actively traded, accounting for 42 percent of the week's total trading value.
National Bank of Oman ended on Wednesday at 3.000 rials from 2.950 rials last week. Oman International Bank was unchanged at 2.570 rials.
